title: 并发加固
implementation: race detector: go test -race ./... -count=1 executed in the Linux container (golang:1.26.3-bookworm) across all packages including the concurrency-critical seams (syncwatcher single in-flight request, dispatch commit/flow, retention worker, confirmation coordinator)
worker lifecycle: runtime workers (scheduler cycle, sync ticker, dispatch stage, retention) share one WaitGroup with context cancellation on Close
single watcher: one sync watcher per instance with generation-gated requests (QUI-09)
worker lease: dispatch stage processes jobs in bounded batches under the caller context
stress and kill -9: the external kill test re-executes a real child process, kills it at the send boundary, and verifies no-replay recovery; the P0 campaign repeated the matrix three times
